entities.summary: Divisional-General Jean-Pierre Lacombe-Saint-Michel was a French Army officer who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He appeared as a character in Les Géorgiques by the novelist Claude Simon, his direct descendant. During the French Revolution, Lacombe-Saint-Michel protected the father of Honoré de Balzac.
